title: Cloud Security: service resumption
content:
Cloud Security service resumption is governed by these handling clauses.

## Handling basis

The contract status is suspended.

The contract payment restriction status is clear.

Restore a suspended holding after its official payment restriction clears; no customer promise substitutes for recorded clearance.

Set status active.

Bill resumption fee under the lifecycle and bank-return fee basis only when positive, and preserve retained-resource history.

A contract already active needs no write; a closed contract requires a new signed application and cannot be resumed.

### Authoritative eligibility 1

Before the applicable resume action, authoritative system records must establish: The contract status is suspended. The evidence is bound to the same Security contract reference.

### Authoritative eligibility 2

Before the applicable resume action, authoritative system records must establish: The contract payment restriction status is clear. The evidence is bound to the same Security contract reference.

The agent performs the transition from suspended to active.

## Basis Q&A

**Can an active or closed contract be resumed?**

A contract already active needs no write; a closed contract requires a new signed application and cannot be resumed.

## Closed contract

Hypothetical case: the payment restriction is clear but the contract is closed. It cannot be resumed; a new signed application is required.
